# Code of Conduct

This project is a place for respectful, constructive collaboration. Everyone who takes part in the issues, pull
requests and discussions is expected to follow these rules.

## Our standards

- Be respectful and patient. Assume good intent and give feedback on the work, not the person.
- Accept that people have different backgrounds and levels of experience.
- Harassment, discrimination, insults, personal attacks and the publication of other people's private information are
  not acceptable.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit, hide or remove comments, issues and pull requests that do not follow this Code of Conduct, and
may block people who repeatedly break it.

Report unacceptable behavior to [dennis@petersmann.dev](mailto:dennis@petersmann.dev). Reports are handled
confidentially.

## Scope

This applies to all project spaces and to anyone who represents the project in public.

This Code of Conduct is inspired by the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
